mechanism: Sacubitril inhibits neprilysin, increasing accumulation of substance P and other neuropeptides; combined with phenelzine's MAOI activity increases serotonergic and sympathomimetic effects, risking hypertensive crisis and serotonin syndrome.
action: This combination is contraindicated; phenelzine must be discontinued at least 14 days before sacubitril initiation, or sacubitril must be stopped at least 5 days before phenelzine initiation.
